prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [home, new_screen] Desktop Pet Visibility Initialization Stage Screen: Adds a dedicated desktop visibility initialization stage screen before the final wait stage to test pet display rendering on the user's primary screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"headline": "Initializing Desktop Pet Rendering Stage"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "new_visibility_stage", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
1: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Pet Trait Sound Calibration Flow: Rebuilds the companion selection flow on pick_friend with interactive audio preview controls for pet voices and traits.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "components": [{"type": "sound", "label": "Preview Pet Voice Trait", "action": "play", "style": "playful"}]}}
2: [finish, redesign] Interactive Desktop Command Palette Redesign: Redesigns the home intro screen into an interactive desktop command palette where users test summoning, hiding, and talking to their pet before completing onboarding.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Master Desktop Pet Controls", "replace": {"home_welcome": [{"type": "checklist", "role": "home_welcome", "text": "Test desktop pet hotkeys, hiding, and voice interaction controls"}]}}}
3: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Generation Sound and Animation Preview Screen: Adds a dedicated pet sound and animation preview screen right after custom photo upload to confirm output before finalizing adoption.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"show_progress": true}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_generation_preview", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign-In Existing Pet Data Recovery Notification Hint: Displays a clear sign-in hint explaining that logging in automatically restores all existing pets, customization data, and saved states.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing back in automatically restores all your previously adopted desktop pets and saved settings."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Interactive Pet Trait Loading Stage Timer: Adds an interactive stage timer and mascot progress indicator to the waiting screen while background rendering completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true, "components": [{"type": "timer", "style": "highlight", "text": "Estimated desktop initialization time: 2 minutes"}]}}
6: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Interactive Sound & Animation Experience Redesign: Redesigns the intro story screen with interactive mascot animation elements prior to path selection.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "spotlight", "replace": {"intro_story": [{"type": "animation", "role": "intro_story", "asset": "asset:companion_intro", "style": "playful"}]}}}
7: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Certificate Mascot Trait Badge Reward: Adds an interactive trait owner badge component to the adoption certificate screen celebrating pet adoption completion.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Official Desktop Companion Owner Badge Unlocked", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Pet Quick Practice Interaction Checklist Flow: Introduces a step-by-step practice interaction checklist on home_intro to verify desktop pet summoning and hotkeys.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "stage", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Press Alt+P to summon or dismiss your desktop pet", "style": "rounded"}]}}
9: [home, notification] Desktop Generation Status System Tray Notification Alert: Enables a system notification option on the waiting screen to alert users on their desktop when pet rendering finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will notify your desktop system tray the moment your pet is ready to play!"}}

verdicts.reason: Adding a new visibility testing screen within onboarding preserves all required steps and screen functions.
Adding interactive audio voice preview components to the pick_friend selection flow maintains its core selection job.
Redesigning the home intro screen into an interactive desktop command palette is permitted as home_intro is part of onboarding.
Adding a generation preview screen after photo upload maintains all required onboarding steps and functionality.
Adding an informative sign-in hint about data recovery is an allowed copy/hint addition inside onboarding.
Adding an estimated initialization timer on the waiting screen during actual background rendering complies with fair design rules.
Redesigning the story screen with interactive animations preserves its primary job of introducing the companion.
Adding a companion owner badge component to the adoption certificate maintains the certificate function without violating pricing copy rules.
Adding an interactive practice checklist to home_intro is permitted inside onboarding.
Adding an optional system tray completion notification on the waiting screen is permitted inside onboarding.
